args.evidence: raw.lineitem has 65814 rows but only 60175 distinct order_line_id (orderkey-linenumber). Group by shows duplicate (orderkey=96, linenumber=2) with identical values. Stg_lineitem builds order_line_id from these columns, so duplicates flow downstream causing unique check to fail (5639 duplicates). Duplicates are identical across all columns, indicating batch delivered twice; can be fixed by deduplication in stg_lineitem.
